exit 1
✗ HIGH     MCP server installed from an unpinned package  [AP04] ×1
    ~/.cursor/mcp.json:1  w: npx web-mcp
    Why:  npx/uvx/bunx fetch the newest version at every start. A hijacked or malicious update becomes code running with your agent's access, with no review.
    Fix:  Pin an exact version (for example pkg@1.4.2), or install it once from a reviewed lockfile.
    BRACE checklist E02, E03, C05 · https://braceframework.org/anti-patterns/#ap04-mcp-server-installed-from-an-unpinned-package

✗ HIGH     Agent allowed to run any shell command  [AP06] ×1
    ~/.claude/settings.json:1  allow "Bash"
    Why:  An allow-rule like Bash(*) or a bare Bash lets the agent run any command without asking. That includes curl to send your files out, rm -rf and git push --force.
    Fix:  Allow only the specific commands the task needs, such as Bash(npm test), and keep deny rules for network and destructive commands.
    Template: templates/policy/claude-code/managed-settings.json
    BRACE checklist B01, B05 · https://braceframework.org/anti-patterns/#ap06-agent-allowed-to-run-any-shell-command

2 high  (2 findings). Silence a reviewed line with an 'open-agent-security: ignore' comment, or add an entry to .open-agent-security-ignore.
